phone.changelog: v3.3.48: Movies fixed — movibox streams routed through VPS proxy (CDN rejects headerless video requests).

tv.changelog: v3.12.73: Movies & series fixed — movibox CDN hotlink gate (429) handled: native player now sends Referer/UA headers; web/phone playback streams through the VPS proxy. Live channel thumbnails fixed — dead Sony logos repaired, logos served via image proxy with retry. Live channel playback untouched.

android_tv.changelog: v3.12.85: Live channel logos FIXED — name-based resolution against the verified tv-logos repo (Sony/Star/Colors/Zee/Aaj Tak/NDTV all show real brand logos now; rescue chain direct → tv-logos → proxy → initials so tiles never sit blank). Dock navigation corrected: the content pane no longer shifts when you use the nav bar, focus no longer jumps randomly, DOWN at the bottom of a page opens the nav and UP returns to where you were. Last live row clears the bottom dock.
